Saving the Orbit | NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026

I’m a student and the leader of a team of six girls passionate about space, AI, and technology. Our project explores ways to detect, track, and capture space debris to help create a safer orbital environment.

We value teamwork, creativity, research, and continuous learning. Our interests include AI, programming, data analysis, and 3D simulation. We aim to develop innovative ideas through collaboration.
